base.description:
{Amad}

Repairs the selected golem stack by restoring hit points and removing negative spells. Affected creatures: Flesh Golems, Stone Golems, Iron Golems, Gold Golems, Diamond Golems, Rusty Dragolems and Dragolems. Restored creatures remain until the end of combat.
